items.headline: German advocacy group lodges criminal complaint over Meta AI glasses
items.summary: A German advocacy group has filed a criminal complaint against Meta over its AI-equipped smart glasses, raising privacy and surveillance concerns. The glasses, which incorporate visual recognition capabilities, have become a focal point for civil liberties groups concerned about mass surveillance.
items.why_it_matters: This reflects growing regulatory scrutiny of computer vision systems embedded in consumer devices and their implications for privacy and public surveillance.

items.headline: Flock tightens surveillance rules amid backlash over mass surveillance concerns
items.summary: Police-tech company Flock announced new restrictions on how officers can access its nationwide network of license plate readers, responding to criticism about surveillance overreach and police abuse. The changes aim to restore public trust and recover lost contracts.
items.why_it_matters: Computer vision systems for automated vehicle recognition are facing increased regulatory pressure as policymakers and the public scrutinize their deployment by law enforcement.
